reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was the sachets: one a day, pocket-sized, tear open with one hand, which is exactly what I need in a carry-on every few weeks. The 200 mg is clearly 2 capsules of 100 mg and the QR batch report helps, so I would try one box, but not on auto-ship until I see it works.
objection: It is $1 a day with zero reviews, and I can get bisglycinate capsules for a third of that. I am paying extra for the sachet format and trusting a lab report on a brand I have never heard of.
would_change_my_mind: A few dozen verified reviews, or a lower price around $24 for the first box.
